title: Free Recall with Closed-Loop Stimulation at Encoding (Encoding Classifier)
description: This dataset contains intracranial electrophysiology recordings and behavioral data from a delayed free recall task with real-time closed-loop brain stimulation during encoding. Participants studied word lists, performed distractor arithmetic tasks, and freely recalled words while an L2 logistic regression classifier trained on encoding neural features guided stimulation delivery to optimize memory encoding. Data were collected across multiple clinical sites as part of a collaborative effort to investigate neural mechanisms of memory and the effects of targeted brain stimulation on recall performance.
methods_description: Intracranial electrophysiology recordings were acquired during a delayed free recall task with closed-loop stimulation at encoding. Neural features were extracted using Morlet wavelet transformation (wavenumber = 5, 8 log-spaced wavelets between 3-180 Hz) applied to bipolar recordings in the 0-1366 ms interval after word presentation, following 58-62 Hz notch filtering. An L2 logistic regression classifier was trained on encoding data from prior FR1 sessions to predict subsequent recall. Classifier outputs were used to trigger 500 ms electrical stimulation pulses during encoding on designated lists. Stimulation parameters (anode/cathode labels, amplitude, pulse frequency, pulse width, pulse count) are documented in behavioral event files.
